name: quickdraw-monorepo
description: Quickdraw — the MIT-licensed infinite-canvas whiteboard SDK. Monorepo root.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@quickdrawjs/core && npm run build --workspace=@quickdrawjs/react && npm run build --workspace=@quickdrawjs/react-native
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck --workspace=@quickdrawjs/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@quickdrawjs/react && npm run typecheck --workspace=@quickdrawjs/react-native
scripts.publish:all: npm publish --workspace=@quickdrawjs/core --access public && npm publish --workspace=@quickdrawjs/react --access public && npm publish --workspace=@quickdrawjs/react-native --access public
